# TheOldMastersPrints

> Bilingual (Spanish/English) guides to famous public-domain paintings: what they show, where they hang, dimensions and verified facts. The site belongs to an Etsy shop selling prints (made in the EU) and canvases with free EU shipping.

## Artworks (English)

- [Mona Lisa — Leonardo da Vinci](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/mona-lisa-leonardo-da-vinci/): c. 1503–1519, Louvre, Paris
- [The Starry Night — Vincent van Gogh](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-starry-night-vincent-van-gogh/): 1889, Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), New York

- [Liberty Leading the People — Eugène Delacroix](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/liberty-leading-the-people-eugene-delacroix/): 1830, Louvre, Paris

- [Las Meninas — Diego Velázquez](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/las-meninas-diego-velazquez/): 1656, Museo del Prado, Madrid
- [The Potato Eaters — Vincent van Gogh](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-potato-eaters-vincent-van-gogh/): 1885, Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam

- [The Raft of the Medusa — Théodore Géricault](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-raft-of-the-medusa-theodore-gericault/): 1818–1819, Louvre, Paris
- [The Third of May 1808 — Francisco Goya](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-third-of-may-1808-francisco-goya/): 1814, Museo del Prado, Madrid

- [The Hunters in the Snow — Pieter Brueghel the Elder](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-hunters-in-the-snow-pieter-brueghel-the-elder/): 1565, Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna

- [The Ambassadors — Hans Holbein the Younger](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-ambassadors-hans-holbein-the-younger/): 1533, National Gallery, London
- [The Jewish Bride — Rembrandt](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/the-jewish-bride-rembrandt/): c. 1665–1669, Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam

- [Ivan the Terrible and his son Ivan on November 16, 1581 — Ilya Repin](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/ivan-the-terrible-and-his-son-ivan-on-november-16-1581-ilya-repin/): 1883–1885, Tretyakov Gallery, Moscow

- [Impression, Sunrise — Claude Monet](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/impression-sunrise-claude-monet/): 1872, Musée Marmottan Monet, Paris
- [Reply of the Zaporozhian Cossacks — Ilya Repin](https://theoldmastersprints.com/en/works/reply-of-the-zaporozhian-cossacks-ilya-repin/): 1880–1891, Russian Museum, Saint Petersburg
